prompt: Reference images 1-3 show only the drawing style: take from them the line work, colors, shading and simplicity, never their content or characters. SCENE: tall vertical picture: a cosy plain living room in the evening. The main character lies on its belly on a soft sofa with one open laptop in front of it, chin on its paws, staring at the blank glowing screen with glazed sleepy eyes; above the sofa float about eight small blank video windows, each a plain rounded rectangle with only a small play triangle in the middle. In the foreground stands one plain coffee table crowded with nine dirty mugs with brown coffee rings, some stacked. The flame on the tip of its tail is a tiny dim ember. LAYOUT: the character and sofa are in the middle, whole; the floating video windows in the upper part; the table full of mugs fills the lower part, big and clear; the whole picture is softly coloured with watercolour; no letters or numbers anywhere. If the picture has no specific place, its background is plain near-white paper, even and untinted. The main character stays black with green eyes, orange cheek marks and an orange tail flame. Every surface is clean and unmarked: blank paper, blank screens, plain envelopes, plain walls, unprinted floor. Keep the main subject well inside the frame, away from the edges. Draw everything in exactly the drawing style of the style references.
